propsNotInFigma.tooltipSide: Where its tooltip opens: Figma draws the tooltip on its own.

Type.note: External when `href` is set (a web address), View when `onClick` is set (a screen in the app).

StretchedLink.whyNoFigmaComponent: Draws nothing: an invisible link over a row, so a click anywhere opens its view.

DialogRoot.whyNoFigmaComponent: Draws nothing: it opens and closes a Dialog, which is in Figma.

propsNotInFigma.side: Where it opens beside its trigger.

propsNotInFigma.updatedAt: Times the dot's breath to each update: Figma draws the dot at rest.

propsNotInFigma.pulse: An animation: Figma draws the dot at rest.

propsWithDifferentValuesInFigma.tone: `current` takes its words' colour, which Figma draws as each status.

propsNotInFigma.density: Figma has the row, not the list: a list's spacing is its frame's gap.

DataListStack.whyNoFigmaComponent: Only arranges Data lists with a hairline between groups; Figma draws the stack by hand from Data rows and a divider, as in the Router card.

propsNotInFigma.align: Not in Figma yet: a value with no text baseline sits on the row's middle.

Mix.note: Mixed: `down` and `up` both above 0. Down only: `up` is 0. Empty: both are 0.

Neutral.note: On when `color="neutral"`; any other colour draws a tint.

Last.note: No prop: CSS draws the last node in a list without its line down.

propsNotInFigma.as: The HTML element: it looks the same.

Collapsible.whyNoFigmaComponent: Draws nothing of its own: it shows and hides a panel.

CollapsiblePanel.whyNoFigmaComponent: Draws nothing: it holds what the trigger shows and hides.

CollapsibleTrigger.whyNoFigmaComponent: Draws nothing: it makes its children the button that opens the panel.

Size.note: No prop: it sizes in em to its line of text. Display is a hero figure's size, Compact a row's.

Page.note: No NavRail prop: it's the page whose `NavItem` has `isActive`.

ScreenReaderStatus.whyNoFigmaComponent: Hidden on screen: only a screen reader hears it.

SpokenText.whyNoFigmaComponent: Looks like its children: only what a screen reader hears differs.
